manifest.title: Origin
manifest.appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, Live TV, Trakt, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Faster playback start: Debrid and direct streams start as soon as they are ready. Seek bar previews are made while the film plays. Settings > Playback > Load previews before playing brings back the wait.
